title: Pure Data batch WAV render: rate, duration, envelope times, 440 Hz tone and rerun checks
summary: Pd -nogui -batch renders a 440 Hz osc~ through a vline~ envelope via writesf~ to 16-bit mono 48 kHz WAV; checks rate, duration, envelope times within 2 ms, FFT tone within 5 cents, tail silence and rerun identity.
